approval.note: Trump job approval, net (approve minus disapprove): average of the RealClearPolling (-22.1) and Silver Bulletin (about -22.6) nets as of Oct 29-30, 2026 (-22.35, rounded to the nearest 0.5: -22.5), unchanged from Oct 29. RealClearPolling's page as opened on Oct 30 still showed the 10/9-10/25 average (38.2/60.3); a separate fetch during the same run showed a 10/9-10/29 average of 38.3/59.8 (net -21.5) that includes Rasmussen 41/57 and Emerson 37/57, which would round the blend to -22.0. Silver Bulletin's Oct 29 page prints approve 37.4% and disapprove only as 'about 60 percent', so its net is approximate. FiftyPlusOne's Oct 29 average (35.2/61.7) is a check.
sources: RealClearPolling average, Oct 30 (polls 10/9-10/25 as opened; a later-dated 10/9-10/29 average read 38.3/59.8, net -21.5): 38.2/60.3, net -22.1
Silver Bulletin average, updated Oct 29: approve 37.4%, disapprove 'about 60 percent' (net about -22.6)

specials.note: Average Democratic improvement on the 2024 presidential margin across D-vs-R special elections since January 2025. The Downballot's Oct 20, 2026 update ('Special elections show Democrats headed for a year as good as 2018, if not better') remains paywalled with no tally visible (last checked Oct 30), so the Aug 19 tally stays; MultiState's 2026-only median (+10.4 across 37 contested specials through April) is a different measure and is not used

offyear.note: 2025 governor margin minus the state's 2024 presidential margin
